'''Shock troopers''' were a variant of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], specializing in the use of various non-standard weapons and equipment that operated under both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. They were also distinguishable from standard stormtroopers by their extra heavy plate armor.

==Overview==
[[File:Shock_trooper.jpg|thumb|left|120px|An Imperial shock trooper.]]
[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] shock [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were trained to fulfill various battlefield support roles and carried a wide variety of equipment. Shock troopers were effective against enemy armor columns and in infantry [[lightfight]].<ref name="BF I guide">[[Star Wars Battlefront: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> Some, equipped with [[MiniMag shoulder-launched proton torpedo launcher]] and [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]], acted as anti-vehicle units on the battlefield. They also carried additional explosives, including [[Baradium-core code key thermal detonator]]s and [[KE-6b mine]]s. Shock troopers also carried [[SE-14r light repeating blaster/Legends|SE-14r blasters]] as a back-up sidearm. Certain shock troopers wore [[Armor/Legends|armor]] similar to [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|sandtroopers]].<ref name="BF I" /> Other shock troopers wore a different form of armor.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

==History==
===Galactic Empire===
[[File:Imperial_shock_trooper.jpg|thumb|right|A shock trooper with a rocket launcher.]]
Shock troopers were part of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] since shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order]]<ref name="BF II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> They saw action in a variety of battlefields,<ref name="BF I">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref> and a number were part of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].<ref name="BF II" />

Many were under the command of Imperial [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] driver [[Zarien Kheev]], while others were seen guarding strategic locations throughout the Galactic Empire. During her various missions, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operative [[Rianna Saren]] encountered those shock troopers on several occasions.<ref name="SW:LA">''[[Star Wars: Lethal Alliance]]''</ref>

===Imperial Remnant===
Long after the conclusion of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the former Galactic Empire was reduced to a handful of backwater [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], collectively known as the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. As the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] strengthened its control over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the Remnant focused on organizing its few remaining territories while simultaneously keeping the Imperial Military up to date.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> As a result, the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the Imperial Remnant were superior as professional soldiers in comparison to the stormtroopers of the old Empire. The Remnant also invested a great deal of attention to the shock troopers, the elite within the elite [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]].<ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>

Together, the shock troopers comprised the [[Imperial Elite Guard]], a well-trained military [[unit]] responsible for protecting the government of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]]. By the time of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus]] added the Imperial Remnant to the Galactic Alliance's list of allies. Apart from being the legacy of his [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|grandfather]], the Remnant possessed enough [[Imperial Navy/Legends|ships]], [[Imperial Army/Legends|arms]] and the [[New Order/Legends|right kind of ideology]] to help the Alliance win the war. But even with all of those assets, Caedus was also very impressed with the Elite Guard's shock troopers and their reputation as highly skilled soldiers on the level of Darth Vader's [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].<ref name="Revelation" />

After Caedus successfully negotiated the Imperial Remnant's entry into the war, the combined naval forces of the Alliance and the Remnant rendezvoused at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], one of the rebellious worlds that betrayed the Alliance in order to join [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Confederation]]. A contingent of shock troopers were stationed on the [[Bloodfin (Star Destroyer)|''Bloodfin'']], the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Head of State/Legends|Imperial Head of State]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]. In the midst of the [[Second Battle of Fondor]], the Alliance forces became divided between its two [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Joint-Chiefs of State]], Darth Caedus and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cha Niathal]]; the majority of the Alliance fleet remained loyal to Caedus.<ref name="Revelation" />

When Tahiri Veila, Darth Caedus' [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and enforcer, assassinated Pellaeon for siding with Niathal against her [[Sith Master/Legends|master]], the Imperial Remnant's [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council]] quickly declared their support for Caedus. However, much of the ''Bloodfin's'' crew mutinied in retaliation for the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Pellaeon, thus splitting up the shock troopers between the ones that remained loyal to the Moffs, and the rest that were loyal to the fallen Grand Admiral. When [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and a team of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] infiltrated the ''Bloodfin'', they became caught in the crossfire between the two Imperial sides. At the same time, the shock troopers were fighting to the best of their ability to protect the Moffs while Veila escaped after being personally rescued by Darth Caedus. In the aftermath of the battle, the ''Bloodfin'' was lost and the remaining shock troopers on board were forced to surrender.<ref name="Revelation" /> The Imperial Remnant's shock troopers continued to serve alongside Darth Caedus' [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force|Galactic Alliance forces]] until the end of the Second Galactic Civil War in [[41 ABY]].<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The appearance and function of shock troopers varies in different ''Star Wars'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]]s. While in [[Star Wars: Lethal Alliance|''Lethal Alliance'']] their role and armor is similar to that of regular stormtroopers, in the ''[[Battlefront]]'' video games, the term 'shock trooper' is applied to what appears to simply be a standard stormtrooper armed and equipped for an anti-vehicle role; they wear the standard armor of an Imperial [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|sandtrooper]], with an orange rank pauldron and a large equipment backpack, and they carry a missile launcher well-suited for engaging enemy armored vehicles. Meanwhile, on planets such a [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]], [[Star Wars: Battlefront|''Battlefront'']] depicts shock troopers as [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] armed with missile launchers. In the Dark Forces/Jedi Knight video games, they carry light repeating blasters and have armor similar to the shock troopers in Battlefront.
